# PhxIcons v0.2.1 - Table of Contents

Dynamic icon library for Phoenix LiveView. Auto-discovers, downloads, and inlines SVG icons from multiple providers at compile time.

## Modules

- [PhxIcons](https://phx-icons.hexdocs.pm/PhxIcons.md): 
- [PhxIcons.Provider](https://phx-icons.hexdocs.pm/PhxIcons.Provider.md): Behaviour for icon set providers.

- [PhxIcons.Test](https://phx-icons.hexdocs.pm/PhxIcons.Test.md): Test helpers for asserting icon presence in rendered HTML.
